description: Chief Secretaries Office of Southern Province - Notify the Entertainment Taxes - 2018 of Hambanthota P/S
categorisation: This gazette notification imposes entertainment taxes within the Hambantota Pradeshiya Sabha area under the authority of the Entertainment Tax Ordinance and Provincial Councils Act. It establishes a regulatory requirement (10% tax on entertainment shows) and falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes.
